intro.title: A few steps before you start

hold.title: Put your hand behind the phone
hold.body: Point the phone at the space the cube lives in and gesture in front of the lens. Only your two fingertips show on screen — never the camera feed.

pinch.title: Pinch with thumb + index
pinch.body: Pinch to grab a face, hold still a moment to lock it, then turn your two fingers to twist it.

depth.title: Move nearer/farther to pick a layer
depth.body: After pinching, hand forward = outer, pull back = middle, pull back more = the innermost blocks. Hold still to lock that layer.

intro.perms: Needs two permissions: camera (to read gestures) + motion/gyro (for the 3D view). Allow both in the system prompts after you tap Start.
